string-array.name: inspirations
string-array.item: \"Today hid at least one gift — you found it\"
\"The good stuff hides in the little stuff\"
\"Something lovely is always on its way\"
\"You caught a good thing before it slipped away\"
\"The more good you notice, the more you find\"
\"Every day leaves a little gold behind\"
\"Save the good parts — you\'ll want them later\"
\"Good things love an audience — notice them\"
\"This page is proof your life is full of good\"
\"You\'re building a museum of good days\"
\"Little by little, the good adds up\"
\"Write it down before the day forgets\"
\"Your future self will love reading this\"
\"Noticing joy is a skill — you\'re practicing it\"
